reviews.name: Jairo Straten
reviews.text: We booked car from Kadapa to Ahobilam. Car was clean and the journey was comfortable. Driver was friendly and everything went smoothly. Reasonable pricing.
reviews.ownerResponse: Dear Jairo Straten, thank you for choosing MANA Tours & Travels for your Ahobilam pilgrimage trip. We are glad you enjoyed the clean car, smooth ride, and courteous service! — MANA Tours & Travels (Owner)

reviews.name: Dr. Srinivas Reddy
reviews.text: Spotless cars and always on time for my hospital rounds in Kadapa. Fixed, transparent billing every single time — no surprises. Pavan is extremely professional and I have referred MANA Tours to all my colleagues.
reviews.ownerResponse: Thank you so much, Dr. Reddy! Your trust and referrals mean the world to us. We look forward to serving you and your colleagues. — MANA Tours & Travels (Owner)

reviews.name: Karthik & Friends
reviews.text: Came all the way from Bangalore for the Gandikota canyon trip. Pavan guided us to the best sunset viewpoints, knew all the hidden spots, and drove absolutely safely on the ghat roads. 10/10 experience — already planning our next trip with MANA!
reviews.ownerResponse: Karthik & friends, your enthusiasm made our day! Gandikota at sunset is truly magical and we're thrilled you loved it. See you next time! — MANA Tours & Travels (Owner)

reviews.name: Venkatesh Naidu
reviews.text: Booked the Innova Crysta for a 4-day Srisailam road trip. The car had new tyres, was freshly serviced, and spotlessly clean. Best part — instant deposit refund right at the doorstep the moment we returned. Absolutely trustworthy service!
reviews.ownerResponse: Thank you Venkatesh! Srisailam road trips in the Crysta are truly wonderful. We keep our fleet road-trip ready always. Drive safe and see you again! — MANA Tours & Travels (Owner)

reviews.name: Padma Laxmi
reviews.text: Travelling with elderly parents to Tirupati is stressful but Pavan made it completely peaceful. He waited patiently during the darshan, helped with luggage, and the car was immaculate and cool throughout. Very affordable for such premium service. Heartily recommended!
reviews.ownerResponse: Padma garu, it is our privilege to be part of your Tirupati darshan. Your parents' comfort is our priority. Jai Balaji! — MANA Tours & Travels (Owner)

reviews.name: Ravi Kumar Sharma
reviews.text: Had an early morning 4 AM flight from Hyderabad. Booked MANA for airport drop — driver arrived 15 minutes early, spotless Swift Dzire, played soft music, and I reached the airport with time to spare. No last-minute calls, no stress. This is the only cab I will book for airport runs.
reviews.ownerResponse: Ravi garu, 4 AM pickups are no problem for us — punctuality is our promise! Safe travels always. — MANA Tours & Travels (Owner)

reviews.name: Anitha Venkataramana
reviews.text: Booked Kadapa to Chennai for a medical appointment. Jyothi handled my booking instantly on WhatsApp, sent the driver details the night before, and the driver was waiting well before time. The fare was exactly what was quoted — zero hidden charges. Will book every time!
reviews.ownerResponse: Thank you Anitha! We hope your medical visit went well. We will always be here for every journey, big or small. — MANA Tours & Travels (Owner)

reviews.name: Mohammed Ismail
reviews.text: Rented the Swift Dzire for a weekend. Process was smooth — sent my DL, Aadhaar, and security deposit via WhatsApp and the car was ready within an hour. No unnecessary inspections or delays. Fuel-efficient, clean, and well-maintained. Returning customer for sure!
reviews.ownerResponse: Thank you Mohammed! Our KYC process is designed to be fast and hassle-free. See you again next weekend! — MANA Tours & Travels (Owner)

reviews.name: Lakshmi Devi & Family
reviews.text: We booked the Innova for a family pilgrimage to Srisailam — 6 adults including elderly grandparents. The cab was spacious, AC was perfect, and the driver was incredibly respectful and patient. He even helped our grandparents climb the temple steps. True service with a heart!
reviews.ownerResponse: Lakshmi garu, assisting devotees — especially our elders — on their pilgrimage is a blessing for us. Om Namah Shivaya! — MANA Tours & Travels (Owner)

reviews.name: Suresh Babu
reviews.text: Our company has been using MANA Tours for employee pickups and drops for 3 months now. Zero delays, professional drivers, and Pavan sends monthly reports on time. Invoicing is clean and GST-compliant. Highly recommend for any corporate transport needs in Kadapa.
reviews.ownerResponse: Thank you Suresh garu! Corporate reliability is our speciality. We're proud to be your transport partner and look forward to a long association! — MANA Tours & Travels (Owner)
